name: Alistair Murdoch
bio:
Alistair’s motorsport journey began with a childhood spent tinkering with engines on his family's sheep farm. He pursued mechanical engineering, quickly finding his niche in racing through university Formula SAE. After gaining experience in smaller domestic series, Alistair moved to South America, drawn by the passionate atmosphere of Brazilian motorsport, eventually landing at Brasil Racing. 

Alistair approaches race engineering with a methodical precision, emphasizing data analysis and clear communication. He believes in a holistic view, understanding how even minor adjustments can impact overall performance. His colleagues value his ability to remain calm under pressure and his knack for identifying problems others often miss. Alistair's 'big picture' thinking has been instrumental in several key strategic victories for the team.

physical.hairStyle: short, neatly combed with a slight wave
physical.description: Alistair is a man of medium height, with a sturdy build and a weathered face that reflects years spent at the racetrack.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with handwritten data points.
Insists on having a cup of strong black coffee precisely 30 minutes before each race.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rhythmically on the table when deep in thought.
